name: Resistive attenuator pads (lossy, 6 dB pad ahead of a 30 Ω section)

example.note: Ideal resistive T pads on a 2 in line: a matched 10 dB, 50 Ω pad; a 50 to 75 Ω pad asked for 0.1 dB, which is held at the 5.72 dB minimum-loss pad, into a 75 Ω line and receiver; and a 6 dB pad in front of a 30 Ω section on a lossy line, which hides that mismatch by twice its loss.
example.author: TDR Painter validation
